lane_change_permitted — DRIVE pass op

• Data kinds: table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.lane_change_permitted(*, follower: 'Optional[dict]' = None, boundary: 'str' = 'none', exception: 'Optional[str]' = None, signal_events: 'Optional[Sequence[dict]]' = None, sudden: 'float' = 2.0) -> 'Dict[str, object]' (to call the implementation directly, import drivepass; drivepass.lane_change_permitted(*, follower: 'Optional[dict]' = None, boundary: 'str' = 'none', exception: 'Optional[str]' = None, signal_events: 'Optional[Sequence[dict]]' = None, sudden: 'float' = 2.0) -> 'Dict[str, object]'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("lane_change_permitted"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Whether a lane change is permitted (judgment by the statute). Scenarios S067, S072, S073.

• follower_sudden_decel (Article 26-2 paragraph 2): with follower = {"gap", "v_follow", "v_ego", "reaction"[, "accel_ego", "min_gap"]}, the deceleration required by lane_change_follower_decel exceeds sudden.

• no_lane_change_marking (Article 26-2 paragraph 3): crossing boundary = "yellow" (road marking prohibiting course changes). Excluded if exception = "article40" (yielding to an emergency vehicle) / "obstruction" (road damage, construction or other obstacles) (items 1 and 2 of the same paragraph).

• signal_* (Article 53 paragraph 1, Rules of the Road 5-5-1 "about 3 seconds before"): violations obtained by scoring signal_events with drivedecide.check_sequence_score (maneuver="lane_change") are added as is (Enforcement Order Article 21 not verified).

Article 26-2 paragraph 1 "needlessly" cannot be expressed numerically, so it is not judged. Returns: ok, reasons, decel, sequence.
